description: This file defines the ContextualLinks class, a Drupal render element for managing and rendering contextual links with support for AJAX and module alterations.

classes.name: ContextualLinks
classes.description: A Drupal render element class for displaying contextual links with support for AJAX and module hooks.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Provides default render array info for the contextual links element.

methods.name: preRenderLinks
methods.description: Pre-render callback that builds the renderable array of contextual links, handling sorting, AJAX detection, and module alterations.

methods.name: contextualLinkManager
methods.description: Returns the service managing contextual links.

methods.name: moduleHandler
methods.description: Returns the module handler service for invoking module hooks.
